## Report — housekeeping run, 2026-09-24 21:02 ET

**T2 decisions:** none. Nothing was due — no pilot event has a snapshot session of 2026-09-24, `due.py t2-list` was empty, and `find events -name gate.json` still returns nothing. No gate, no freeze, no decision, so no freeze commit hashes this run.

**PENDING re-checks — both unchanged, both still PENDING:**

| name | company source | newest item | yfinance | earliest snapshot |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AEHR | aehr.com/newsroom (HTTP 200) | 2026-09-03, Lake Street conference — no FY27 Q1 date | 2026-11-02 15:00 ET, intraday (unchanged) | 2026-10-01 |
| APLD | ir.applieddigital.com press-release RSS (HTTP 200) | 2026-07-27 16:05 ET, Q4 FY2026 results — no FY27 Q1 date | 2026-10-08 16:00 ET (unchanged) | 2026-10-06 |

Neither is late yet: AEHR's ~7-day lead points to an announcement around Sep 28 (four days out), APLD's 12-day lead to around Sep 26 (two days out). I corrected the framing carried in the last two log entries, which described those dates as already missed.

**What went wrong:** the 23:00 UTC fire started ~2 hours late again (19:00 ET due, 21:02 ET actual) — the fourth consecutive day. It cost nothing today because nothing was due, but the same delay is what lost PAYX, DRI and BB. The `due.py wait` fix covers early arrivals, not late ones; a fire this late on a snapshot day would still miss the window. That remains untested until Mon Sep 28 (AIR + JBL).

`check.py` PASS, working tree clean. Committed and pushed as `427c98a` (STATE.md cloud run log + `event_status.json` re-checks).
